body: A 7-billion-parameter instruction-tuned language model for multilingual text generation, coding, and reasoning.
plain_description: **Use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to generate helpful answers, code, and structured text for your business.** It follows instructions, supports long inputs, and works across many languages.
technical_description: An instruction-tuned 7.61B-parameter causal language model in the Qwen2.5 series. The README demonstrates loading it with Hugging Face Transformers and generating text with a chat template. It supports up to 131,072 tokens of context with configuration for long-text use, and recommends vLLM for deployment.
title: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
